scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w apps/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/desktop
